scope: Five GBIF name-screen exceptions among 58 Hays candidates
review_authority: Kew Plants of the World Online (WCVP-derived taxonomic treatment)
process: Independent name cross-check only; no photo ID and no wild population confirmation

records.name: Coelorachis cylindrica
records.kew_treatment: Coelorachis cylindrica is a synonym of Rottboellia campestris under current POWO; FNA 2003 historically used Coelorachis cylindrica.
records.action: Keep as Hays candidate; resolve accepted genus and Flora description before card creation.

records.name: Echinochloa colona
records.kew_treatment: Kew accepts Echinochloa colona; GBIF fuzzy matched Echinochloa colonum; this fuzzy match is not reason to discard the taxon.
records.action: Retain as distinct field-ID candidate; specimen/observation photos still need review.

records.name: Elymus glabriflorus
records.kew_treatment: Kew POWO treats Elymus glabriflorus as a synonym of Elymus virginicus; the current 112 includes Elymus virginicus. Alternative taxonomy has sometimes accepted glabriflorus separately.
records.action: PROPOSED_DUPLICATE: compare Flora treatment; preserve original iNaturalist IDs but do not build second card unless Flora-based taxon concept warrants it.

records.name: Tridentopsis elongata
records.kew_treatment: Kew accepts Tridentopsis elongata as distinct from T. mutica and T. buckleyana; GBIF fuzzy matched an unrelated Trisetopsis elongata. Do not adopt that GBIF fuzzy genus.
records.action: Retain as separate Hays candidate, pending identification and Flora verification.

records.name: Janochloa antidotalis
records.kew_treatment: Kew accepts Janochloa antidotalis (formerly Panicum antidotale); GBIF only matched the family Poaceae and did not resolve this newer combination.
records.action: Retain as one-record Hays candidate; especially scrutinize whether photographed individual is correctly identified and naturally established.
